Description.Value:
NOT AUTOMATIC: press Alt+B in game to hear it. No bake and no install step - just enable the mod.
Adds two short sounds Phoenix Point never shipped, baked into this mod's own Wwise bank, and plays one at random on Alt+B. Requires the ContentTool mod.
That bank ships ALREADY BUILT inside Dist\AddUiSounds.bundle and this mod's own DLL loads it the moment the mod is enabled, so a download plays as it stands: measured 2026-08-28 with no bake command ever run, the two added events answered 1489 ms and 653 ms, both served from memory. 'ct_project AddUiSounds' is the AUTHOR's command, for rebuilding that bundle after editing Content\Audio; a player never needs it.
It ships a DLL, and that is the lesson: the sounds themselves are content, but a hotkey is BEHAVIOUR and behaviour is code. Its twin, ContentTool Demo: Replace UI Sounds, replaces shipped sounds instead and needs no code at all.
